name: Spotlight Grid Reveal
description: A flashlight cursor wanders a dark page, revealing a glowing grid, feature tags and the headline under a soft circle, then the light opens to fill the frame and the CTA appears.
move: A flashlight cursor wanders a dark page, revealing a glowing grid, feature tags and the headline under a soft circle, then the light opens to fill the frame and the CTA appears.
how: Two copies of one scene: a near-black base and a lit copy masked by radial-gradient(circle var(--r) at var(--x) var(--y)). The cursor walks a Catmull-Rom route with an in-out sine; then --r grows to 1500px with an in-out cubic while the centre drifts to frame centre.
adapt: Edit SCENE (headline and tag positions) and the PTS route. Placeholder product names and copy are generic. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: Pure draw(t): mount the markup in the shot and call draw from the film's frame hook with shot-local time; wait for fonts before sampling or measuring.
caveats: Original implementation; no third-party UI kit, product or brand assets.
Starts and ends on its opening frame so it loops; trim the exit when cutting to the next shot.
